normal_ra_messages.instructions: CBA HERO 4v4: RAHOW TO PLAYUnits spawn automatically and march into the arena. Defeat enemy units to unlock stronger heroes. Protect your four Castles and destroy every enemy Castle to win.TEAMSBlue, Red, Green, and Yellow face Teal, Purple, Gray, and Orange. Close any unused slots, but keep at least one occupied color on each side.TEAM ROUTESGuarded rear team routes connect allies through wider sixteen-tile sections. Gate entrances remain narrow. Enemy units entering these routes are killed, even after a teammate is defeated. Use the central battlefield to attack.POPULATIONChoose the shared population limit in the lobby before starting. Armies, Heroes, builders and backup use normal population; full builder pairs and six-Scorpion backup wait for enough free room. No in-game population chooser.SPAWN CONTROLSSheep = Castle army range. Penguin = Hero range. Move each along its own road: farther toward the arena sends new units farther. Snow is the end zone: Sheep on snow = HOLD (new armies stay by your Castles); Penguin on snow = OFF (no new Heroes). The road begins exactly where HOLD/OFF ends. The Penguin's first ON position sends Heroes right in front of your Castles, like Army HOLD. Water keeps each controller on its own track. New waves receive one automatic move order.WALL WIPEDelete the side switch gate to remove your side walls. Front gates/walls and the University gate/enclosure stay. At 200 walls you get a warning; at 220 the wall-limit wipe clears other walls once. Fixed barriers are excluded.VOTE KICKDelete the matching Vote Kick marker to vote against a teammate. Two occupied teammates must vote. Voting is disabled when fewer than three colors remain on that side, and closed slots never count as votes.COMBAT HUDThe right-side Kills / Deaths / Razings list shows live combat totals for P1 through P8. B = Scorpion Backup: 1 available, A active, 0 used.SCORPION BACKUPMove your Skorpion King to the marked side island to call six Scorpions for 50 seconds. Each player can use this backup once.Resources stay at zero; available units, buildings, upgrades, and repairs are free.MIRRORED CIVILIZATIONSFor exact pairs, select the same civilization explicitly for P1/P5, P2/P6, P3/P7, and P4/P8 in the lobby. The game resolves Mirror before the scenario starts; this map cannot reassign those engine choices.HERO MILESTONES200 Robin Hood | 400 Theodoric | 600 Charles Martel800 Harald Hardrada | 1000 Genghis | 1500 faster Genghis2000 Super Genghis | 2501 rapid Super Genghis | 3001 SGK2503500 faster SGK250 | 5000 dual SGK250. No adrenaline fire-rate multiplier.
normal_ra_messages.hints: Defeat enemy units to ascend through eleven hero tiers. Protect all four Castles, move the Sheep to set Castle-army travel, move the Penguin to control Hero production and travel, and use the rear gates to reinforce your allies.
normal_ra_messages.history: CBA Hero 4v4: RA v1.9.Automatic armies earn stronger heroes through combat. Guard four Castles, support your allies through the protected team routes, and destroy every enemy Castle.
normal_ra_messages.loss: DEFEATYour Castles have fallen. Return to the map to watch the battle.
normal_ra_messages.scouts: Blue/Red/Green/Yellow face Teal/Purple/Gray/Orange. Close unused slots while keeping both color teams represented. Every territory has equal mirrored terrain and defenses.
normal_ra_messages.victory: RA VICTORYYour team destroyed every enemy Castle.
